interviewer_notes: Takes 4-5 days at each month end. Data collection and re-keying are the biggest bottleneck. The CFO is tied up in variance analysis, which is delaying management decisions.

tasks.name: Collect sales data
tasks.description: Collect sales data from each department in Excel
tasks.ai_fit_reason: Repetitive collection in a fixed format. Email attachments can be ingested automatically
tasks.ai_role: Auto-sorting email, collecting files, normalising formats

tasks.name: Transcribe and consolidate data
tasks.description: Transcribe and consolidate the collected Excel files into one master sheet
tasks.ai_fit_reason: Rule-based transcription. Error detection can be automated too

tasks.name: Enter journal entries
tasks.description: Enter journal entries into the accounting system from the consolidated data
tasks.output: Journal entries recorded in the accounting system
tasks.ai_fit_reason: Entry patterns can be turned into rules, but exceptions and the final check need a human
tasks.ai_role: Drafting entries and pattern matching (final approval by a human)

tasks.name: Variance analysis
tasks.description: Analyse variances against last month and budget, and write commentary
tasks.input: Trial balance from the accounting system
tasks.ai_fit_reason: AI can compare figures and draft commentary. Interpretation involving management judgement stays with a human

tasks.name: Prepare the management report
tasks.description: Prepare the monthly management report for the board
tasks.ai_fit_reason: AI can structure slides and insert figures. The management message is written by a human
tasks.ai_role: Auto-inserting figures into the template and proposing a slide structure

tasks.name: Prepare audit materials
tasks.description: Organise and submit supporting documents to the external auditor
tasks.output: A complete set of audit files
tasks.ai_fit_reason: High legal and compliance significance; the final decision must always be made by a human
tasks.ai_role: Only building a document checklist and helping organise files

tasks.name: Process invoices
tasks.description: Receive supplier invoices, reconcile them, and register payment
tasks.ai_fit_reason: Extraction by OCR and reconciliation lend themselves well to automation
tasks.ai_role: Reading by OCR, automatic reconciliation against purchase orders, drafting the payment record
